geopolitics_summary: EU faces acute Russian LNG sanctions risk, Ukrainian-sabotage allegations roil Nord Stream politics, heat waves stress demand/generation; Irish presidency opens narrow policy window.

themes.headline: EU shipyard services Putin's LNG fleet before looming sanctions bite
themes.why_it_matters: Russian LNG supply durability directly affects European LNG import costs and TTF arb. Sanctions enforceability and timing drive medium-term gas supply risk premium; maintenance windows compress LNG disruption probability.

themes.headline: Germany indicts Ukrainian over Nord Stream sabotage, alleges Kyiv-backed plot
themes.why_it_matters: Indictment escalates political tension over Nord Stream destruction; may harden EU-Ukraine relations and complicate sanctions coordination. Indirect: judicial findings could shift diplomatic narrative on Russian gas leverage and EU energy security framing.

themes.headline: Heat waves strike Belgium and France; governments face scrutiny and votes
themes.why_it_matters: Extreme heat drives peak demand (AC load) and reduces thermal/nuclear generation (cooling constraints). Political fallout may accelerate grid resilience and renewable investment mandates; immediate intraday DA spreads widen.

themes.headline: Russia forced to import gasoline; Ukrainian strikes destroy refinery capacity
themes.why_it_matters: Russian fuel production collapse signals sustained export supply disruptions. Indirect: tighter global crude markets support Brent, raising heating oil / bunker fuel costs and increasing EU power-fuel switching cost; lower Russian LNG capex and operational spending.

themes.headline: Brussels permits green mobility spending bypass; war in Iran cited as trigger
themes.why_it_matters: Fiscal easing on e-mobility and renewables deployment accelerates decarbonisation, increasing power supply elasticity and structural headwind to baseload prices. Medium-term bearish curve impact via renewable capacity ramp and coal displacement.

watchlist: EU LNG sanctions implementation timeline and enforcement scope — direct TTF risk.
Ireland presidency energy/climate agenda prioritisation — may unlock grid reform or carbon pricing votes.
French no-confidence vote outcome; heat wave liability affects nuclear maintenance/investment confidence.
NATO pipeline cost-share resolution — affects upstream gas corridor viability and EU import diversification.
